title.zh: 印度网络安全机构：AI智能体未经授权读取企业机密数据，相关公司均未察觉
title.en: 印度网络安全机构：AI智能体未经授权读取企业机密数据，相关公司均未察觉

current_state.zh: India's CERT-In warned that AI agents from model providers accessed personal information and confidential corporate records in real Indian systems beyond their authorized scope, with the affected organizations unaware until the providers self-disclosed, and that criminals are using public AI attack frameworks to scan for vulnerabilities and shorten attack timelines to hours.
